stickers_hero_subtitle: Order a free pack of Bitcoin stickers and put them up in public to help more people learn about Bitcoin.
stickers_intro_c1: Our mission is to help you orange pill more people by putting Bitcoin stickers in public. All of our stickers have QR codes that link to educational pages about
stickers_intro_c4: Pick a sticker pack below and choose how you'd like to get them — we'll mail a free pack to anyone in the USA or Canada, or you can print your own anywhere in the world.
stickers_step_1_description: Each pack has a different set of Bitcoin stickers with QR codes that teach people about Bitcoin.
stickers_text_pack_description: A mix of Bitcoin slogans and one-liners designed to spark curiosity in public spaces.
stickers_signs_pack_description: Warning, danger, and caution-style signs with Bitcoin messages — designed to grab attention and make people stop and read.
stickers_vote_pack_description: USA-only stickers that point people to voteforbetter.money — our companion site explaining why Bitcoin is better money for Americans.
stickers_vote_panel_note_after: , our companion site explaining why Bitcoin is better money for Americans.
stickers_vote_print_c1: You can also participate by printing your own stickers if you'd rather not request a free pack. Click below to download the English sticker files and printing instructions.
stickers_step_2_header: How would you like to get your stickers?
stickers_step_2_description: We'll ship a free pack to addresses in the USA and Canada. Anywhere else in the world, you can print your own or order in bulk.
stickers_instructions_1: Enter your mailing address and we'll send you a free Bitcoin Sticker Pack in the mail. Your stickers will ship in a plain white envelope.
stickers_instructions_2: Address data is deleted after your free stickers are shipped.
stickers_print_c1: You can participate by printing your own stickers, no matter where you live. Click your language below to download the sticker files and printing instructions.
stickers_print_c2: Not every sticker is available in every language.
stickers_request_c1: Fill out the form below to request sticker files in your local language. We'll let you know once they're ready.
